title: semver: add Range#filter and semver.filterSatisfying
prompt: This is a copy of node-semver. Add two things. (1) `Range.prototype.filter(versions)`: returns the entries of the `versions` array that satisfy the range, as the original entries (strings or SemVer objects, not copies) in input order, silently skipping entries that are not valid versions; it follows the options the Range was built with. (2) `semver.filterSatisfying(versions, range, options)`: a new file ranges/filter-satisfying.js, exported from index.js in the same way as maxSatisfying/minSatisfying, built on Range#filter; an invalid range returns an empty array instead of throwing.
